zh: 邮箱登录改为 App 内原生体验，并优化了 GitHub 登录流程
升级后需要手动重新登录一次：用原来的邮箱或 GitHub 账号登录即可，仍是同一个账号
en: Email sign-in is now a native in-app experience, and the GitHub sign-in flow has been improved
You'll need to sign in again after this update: use your original email or GitHub account and you'll land on the same account
